## Checklist

- [ ] **I have read and agree to [CLA.md](../CLA.md).** (Required. Pull requests without this cannot be merged.)
- [ ] Type check and smoke tests pass locally (`npx tsc --noEmit -p .` and `npx playwright test tests/smoke.spec.ts`).
- [ ] Player-facing text has no em or en dashes and never uses the word "failed".
- [ ] New numbers or legal mechanics have a public source (and a `// attorney review` comment for legal mechanics).
- [ ] Any new asset is CC0 or my own work, and is listed in `public/assets/CREDITS.md`.
- [ ] Screenshots attached for anything visible.
